title: Undirected regular multigraph
statement: A regular multigraph of degree $D$ on a type $V$ assigns to each vertex $v$ and each of its $D$ edge slots a neighboring vertex. It is undirected in the sense that, for every pair of vertices $u,v$, the number of edge slots at $u$ leading to $v$ equals the number of edge slots at $v$ leading to $u$.
hypotheses_covered: A type of vertices with decidable equality
